title: Reel 4: scaring Paul and the cards in the trash can
summary: Reel 4 begins with the band staging a spirit prank on Paul, which ends with his mailed postcards ending up in a trash can in Toronto.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: Pops Foster with Darnell Howard, April 21st, 1957, reel four. So we're going to go in the room, we're going to talk to some Spurridge. He's supposed to have a chicken come off this room, so we wouldn't have had this chicken. So put all the lights on, put the table in the middle of the floor, they'd sit over there, and I'm sitting over there on the corner. We're supposed to call him Spurridge, you know. Spurridge was supposed to come, Paul in bed. He's in bed half asleep, all the juice, and we're going to call it Spurridge, you know. So put the lights on, call it Spurridge. We talk about that foolish talk. He got up in his ribs and bricks and stuff and throw it and run us all out the damn room. And the chick seen us coming out of the room so fast, they thought she wouldn't come, so she went and called him, said she couldn't come there. It looked like they had a fight, but we made him miss that. He's still mad with us. So I made him, he wrote about 20 cards, which is in Toronto, Canada.
You don't have to rush time. You have to wait for this one, don't you?

So I said, mail them right here. Guess what I told you, the mailers call here. You know, around the county they have the mailbox and your dirt can. Look just like the mailbox. I said, mail them, he put all them cards. So the trash man had come around and pick up and all these letters fell out the way he put them, you know. I got to the mailers to this hotel. Somebody mail their cars in the trash can and I left the hotel right away. They didn't see me until Louis didn't see me, because I stayed at the New Styler in Toronto with Louis. Well, they live around the corner. I go around there. Well, every time when I says, I need the band to come tell them I'm out, see, I was upstairs. I said, I want to see you, man, I want to be here. I said, I want to see you, because then when you get off. Louis said, Louis, what's the matter, man? I said, that dumbest man mail all his cars in the damn trash can and he put it on me. I said, . I got it. Mail all his trash can, man. That's funny. You should have heard him, Nick and Bronnie, do the three. That wasn't even much younger. Yeah. Well, we do some crazy things. And I still, I still pull off some funny things. I'm still one of these cigarettes. Help yourself. I still pull off some funny things.
